'''High Officer''' was a title in use by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. [[Mals Tonith]] was the High Officer of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] during the ninth century of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
